description: Debug logging that writes real secrets to stdout (and from there to Vercel/Datadog logs): the JWT signing secret at module load, the user's plaintext password on every login attempt, the freshly issued session JWT, the Stripe secret key held in a camelCase variable, an env var read inline (process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY), the Supabase service-role key (which bypasses RLS) logged as an object shorthand property, and a customer's API key read straight from the x-api-key request header (req.headers.get("x-api-key")) in the public API's auth helper. VC147 must fire on every one of those lines. The 'Invalid credentials for <email>' warning logs no secret and is not expected.
